task.title: Make Management AI return an actual provider answer with bounded degradation

scope.owned_layer: Management NL provider orchestration, OpenClaw answer-readiness truth, and durable conversation replay verification
not_changing: The existing POST /bff/management/nl/ask endpoint and ManagementAiConversationStore ownership
Product BFF development-tooling or repository access
Kernel debug write authority, UI action routing, security redesign, or live-capital behavior
composes_with: PFG-DEV-INTEGRATION-20260820 dev Compose and hosted deployment admission

provider_inventory.readiness_contract: OpenClaw ready=true requires a completed non-empty bounded CLI answer probe; URL-only inventory reads report not_checked.
provider_inventory.fallback_contract: Only an explicitly configured fallback that returns a completed non-empty answer is used. Otherwise the primary typed degraded reason remains visible with deterministic_synthesis fallback.

behavioral_proof.inner_degraded_response: An outer adapter status=ok with data.status=degraded is classified as failed. Its message cannot be exposed as a provider answer.
behavioral_proof.deadline: A single monotonic deadline is shared by the primary and all configured fallback attempts; the BFF client receives only the remaining per-attempt timeout.
behavioral_proof.correlation_and_replay: Fallback attempts retain the exchange trace_id and use distinct provider_run_id values. Durable idempotency replay reloads the conversation store without invoking a provider or appending a duplicate assistant turn.
behavioral_proof.degradation: When no configured provider returns a completed non-empty answer, POST /bff/management/nl/ask retains typed provider_status and serves the existing deterministic synthesis.

validation.environment: task-local Python 3.12 virtualenv; no provider credentials or live-capital authority used

commands.command: Focused provider-failover, typed-inner-degradation, restart-replay, OpenClaw bounded-answer readiness, and inventory-not-ready tests

real_provider_dev_smoke.required_probe: After this exact PR head is deployed to dev, send an authenticated Management NL question and verify a completed non-empty provider answer, or a typed degraded result within the configured deadline.

review.reviewer_instruction: Bind this already-committed manifest with AI_NAME=Antigravity2 REVIEW_FILE=<this path> through the governed approve command only after independently checking the exact PR head.
review.owner_claim: Owner evidence ready for independent review; this file makes no approval claim.
